test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_snappy_strings_{max_dictionary_size}.parquet', Parquet) SELECT if(cityHash64(intDiv(number, 4)) % 8 = 0, concat('search phrase ', toString(cityHash64(number) % 20000)), '') AS phrase, ['', '', '', 'iPhone', 'iPad', 'GT-I9300', 'Lumia 920'][cityHash64(intDiv(number, 16)) % 7 + 1] AS model FROM numbers(30000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_compression_method = 'snappy', output_format_parquet_max_dictionary_size = {max_dictionary_size}, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT phrase, model FROM file('test_parquet_snappy_strings_{max_dictionary_size}.parquet', Parquet) FORMAT Null
SELECT count(DISTINCT phrase) FROM file('test_parquet_snappy_strings_{max_dictionary_size}.parquet', Parquet) FORMAT Null
